subject: Quick confirmation needed before deadline
text: Could someone confirm whether the committee needs the signed liability form attached to my application, or is that separate from the renewal letter? I read the note twice and it still looks like the form is already on file, then later says to upload it before tonight. The deadline wording also seems off because the board email says noon, while the group chat says midnight. Please reply in the thread so we all see the answer. I cannot submit until this is clear, and I do not want another late fee. If the form was received last month, simply say received and ignore the upload request. If it is missing, tell me exactly where to send it and whether a photo is enough. I can bring a paper copy on Thursday if needed. Sorry for the urgency, but my access to the storage room is tied to this paperwork.
